title: Capstone: reproduce a small published-style analysis from zero + research ethics
context: The capstone has an external learner reproduce a small published-style cancer analysis from a clean environment using only the curriculum and gated datasets, and includes a research-ethics + reproducibility section. Medium-risk; requires Domain review.
objective: Author the capstone in both tracks: a reproducible end-to-end small published-style analysis on gated data plus a research-ethics + reproducibility section, reviewed by Domain.

Domain review confirms biological/clinical statements; both R and Python tracks; every claim cited.
